Replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, addressed to you:

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard in the meantime. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM (Mateo checked in trailer 8836), and you confirmed both lanes working at 11:07 AM.

The channel doesn't say more about the guard's activity than that. For the postmortem, Mateo or the gate log would be the place to check.
